component.name: Usage Monitor
component.summary: Monitor AI provider usage from the terminal

description.p: Usage Monitor collects, stores, and displays consumption metrics from AI services like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, and many more — all without depending on external servers.
It ships a command-line interface plus reference desktop widgets for KDE Plasma 6, Waybar, and GNOME Shell, embedded in the binary and installed with `usage-monitor-cli widget install`.
